decisions.decision: Replace per-batch LLM summarization with raw transcript append during meeting
decisions.rationale: Cheaper (no LLM per flush), cleaner .md (readable transcript vs summarized blobs), single LLM call at end-of-meeting for metadata

decisions.decision: MeetingMetadataOutput has: overview, goals, key_decisions, conclusions
decisions.rationale: These are the fields the selection LLM needs to pick the right meeting; populated once at disconnect

decisions.decision: In-memory index cache in MeetingWriterAgent (invalidated on upsert)
decisions.rationale: Avoids disk read on every memory query; safe because upsert always refreshes cache

decisions.decision: Pre-filter entries by channel_id and date window BEFORE LLM selection call
decisions.rationale: Reduces LLM context size 60-80% for common cases; skip LLM entirely when pre-filter uniquely identifies one meeting (only when filters actually narrowed the list)

decisions.decision: Use full_transcript key (not summary_text) for .md content passed to AnswerAgent
decisions.rationale: AnswerAgent now labels it 'Full Meeting Transcript' so LLM knows it has complete content; Pinecone path unchanged (still uses summary_text)

decisions.decision: _speak_lock serializes all voice output (speak, speak_chunked, _stream_llm_and_speak, ack Yes?)
decisions.rationale: Fixes Bug 1a: concurrent wake-word triggers caused audio overlap

decisions.decision: Thread-unique temp filenames in speak() using threading.get_ident()
decisions.rationale: Fixes Bug 1b: hardcoded temp_jarvis.mp3 caused file corruption in concurrent threads
Fixes Bug 2a: disconnect flush racing with time-based flush could both see False and double-write header (w mode truncates file)

decisions.decision: _full_transcript_lines accumulates ALL lines across the whole meeting; only cleared at disconnect
decisions.rationale: _sentence_buffer is periodically drained; full transcript needed for MeetingMetadataAgent at disconnect

next_action: Commit all uncommitted changes, then run /gsd:verify-work 7
